archetypes.name: symilar-parity
archetypes.rationale: Runner relies on Pylint private symilar and linter state semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the duplicate-code runner for parity with Pylint 4.0.5 R0801 semantics. Focus on module discovery, message enablement, pragma handling, astroid ingestion order, and close-equivalent cluster gating. Check that private API drift paths fail closed instead of silently passing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: parallel-pairs
archetypes.rationale: The speedup depends on pair-index parallelism without changing comparison coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the parallel comparison path. Verify it enumerates unordered file-pair indices, does not shard file lists, does not use _iter_sims as a pre-scan, and preserves serial versus parallel digest stability. Pay special attention to worker fallback behavior and exception handling. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: lint-surface
archetypes.rationale: The new CLI target changes CI lint wiring and stdlib-only policy exceptions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the CLI, Makefile, requirements, and stdlib-only gate changes as one lint surface. Verify the new dependency is test/dev scoped, top-level duplicate_code imports remain stdlib-only, and Makefile comments match the actual runner behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
